The significantly low sodium level of 122 mEq/L indicates severe hyponatremia, which is a likely cause of her altered mental status and lethargy. I will now request a CT scan of the head to rule out intracranial pathology and assess urine osmolality to help determine the etiology of the hyponatremia.
